name: Nudges
summary: Frosted notification cards that stack with depth, fan out into a list and swipe away
about: A notification stack over a slowly drifting wallpaper, with a live clock on top. New notifications drop in with a blur and a wiggle and push the older ones deeper into the stack. Show all fans the stack out into a list; tap a card to open its actions and mark it read, swipe it sideways to clear it with a red underlay, or press Clear to sweep them all away and ring the little bell. Do not disturb holds new arrivals until you let them in.
how: Press Show all (or the +N more pill) to fan the stack into a list; Show less or Escape stacks it again.
Swipe a card left or right to clear it, or press its cross; on a keyboard, focus a card and press Delete.
Tap a card (or press Enter) to open it: the message unfolds with two actions, and it is marked read.
Turn on the moon for Do not disturb: new arrivals wait in a pill until you tap it or turn the moon off.
Press Clear to sweep every card away one after another.
